title: query/keys: inclusive retirement second like check?
description: Question for Mark. vouch-ey47.22 made check accept a record dated in its key's retirement second (inclusive, as OpenSSH valid-before). query --at (git-vouch cmd_query, when < key.retired) and keys (now < key.retired) still treat the retirement second as invalid, and tests/test_query.py pins that ('retired is exclusive'). git-vouch-trqp reads validity from query --at, so for T == retired check/OpenSSH say valid while query/bridge say invalid (fails closed). Options: (a) make query/keys inclusive (when <= key.retired) and update DESIGN and test_query; (b) keep query strict and leave the documented split as DESIGN now states it. Needs the core and docs locks.
notes: 2026-10-23 core-robust: done as option (a), the orchestrator's instruction for this unit: key_valid() shared by query --at and keys, whole seconds, retirement second inclusive. test_query and trqp test_context_time updated as the main session's note asked. Side effect: tests/patatt/test_patatt.py::test_retired_key_fails is now flaky (retire-key writes _now() in whole seconds and patatt's git vouch keys in the same second still lists the key); it failed once in the full 3.12 run, passes alone. Patatt lane: wait into the next second before validating, or accept it as the documented semantics.
close_reason: query --at and keys share key_valid with an inclusive retirement second (test_query valid-at cases, trqp test_context_time)
